data.scope: Nu global active customer average, revenue not profit; not marginal revenue or NuCel ARPU
Nu global; not affected population for any case
Nu global; not a baseline for a case

rules: Case incidence, causal uplift and marginal costs are not public. Every such number below must be labeled explicit scenario assumption.
Never multiply a complaint value by all139m customers. No financial result has been observed from these proposals.
Report customer money released separately from bank revenue and operating savings. Never call principal a gain.
No total across cases: cohorts overlap. Separate currencies; no invented exchange rate.
Break-even = one-off build cost / positive monthly net operating contribution. Show no break-even when <=0.
Do not apply global ARPAC to NuCel or infer cost/contact from monthly cost-to-serve.
Reduced handling time is capacity freed, not cash saved unless scheduling/cost actually changes.
